svg.title: How stackdraw works
svg.desc: How stackdraw works. 16 components in 5 groups. Connections: Agent or editor to diagram.yaml (writes); diagram.yaml to Validate; Validate to ELK layout; ELK layout to Check; Check to Render; AWS to Render; Azure to Render; Google Cloud to Render; Kubernetes to Render; Render to Octicons, Carbon, logos, Tabler (first use); Validate to Bundled icon packs; Render to SVG; Render to PNG; Render to draw.io; Render to React TSX; Render to HTML viewer.

text.tspan: One YAML spec in, five formats out, with official icons and automatic layout
